intro: A small, sturdy barrel has its seams sealed with pungent yellow wax. A stamp on its base names Quartermaster Lungertz and Nethergarde Keep, and that is where it belongs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This barrel is small yet sturdy. Its seams are sealed with a yellow, pungent wax. Stamped on the bottom of the barrel are the words:

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, thank you friend! So many supplies are lost from Darkshire to here. It's good to see that some are recovered.
